messages:
rebekah_sales: QuartzPay (regulated payments) asked for a Private Deploy POC: no general internet egress (only 3 hostnames), preserve client src IP in logs, KMS BYOK, and a POC vs reserved pricing estimate. Need a short network playbook to share with their infra team.

mike_netops: Two recommended topologies: 1) cross-account VPC peering — preserves srcIP, requires route table entries and no NAT; 2) PrivateLink — simpler from an isolation POV but our ENIs will SNAT so srcIP lost. If srcIP is non-negotiable, choose peering.

taylor_solutions: If peering is blocked, propose a customer-side proxy that attaches X-Forwarded-For. Call out app change needed.

ana_security: KMS: we support BYOK via AWS KMS cross-account grants; Enterprise can request HSM-backed CMKs. Keys remain customer-controlled; rotation via their KMS policy. I'll draft questionnaire text.

leo_engineer: Firewall snippet for ops: AWS SG egress allow 203.0.113.10/32, 203.0.113.11/32 on TCP/443 and allow DNS to 198.51.100.5/32. If they need hostname allowlist use an outbound HTTPS proxy — we can provide proxy IPs for POC. Minimal iptables to force-proxy: 'iptables -t nat -A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.0.0.5:3128' then allow proxy IPs, drop rest.

ci_bot: Ticket created: SALES-4820 - "QuartzPay POC connectivity + KMS pack". Owner: mike_netops. ETA: 48h.

rebekah_sales: Great. Action items: Mike produce one-page playbook (decision matrix + diagram + SG/iptables snippets). Ana finalize KMS wording. Leo draft POC pricing rows (30d POC discount, 90d trial, monthly reserved commit). I'll loop in quartzpay-net once ready. :thumbsup:
